markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (52%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs Benign · Careful review
Normal (52%) barely edges out Benign (47%) on a simulated frozen section, while invasive risk is 0% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 52%, Benign 47%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Nearly tied Normal vs Benign |
| Conformal set | {Normal, Benign} (90% target; 90% test coverage, CI 76%–98%) | Cannot separate Normal from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 76th percentile OOD, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Acceptable quality despite resampling degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Two independent models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (86%–88% similarity); contrast Benign (85%) [F5] | Nearest reference cases all Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical stromal infiltration (-0.74 contribution) strongly pushes away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 9) · context · Below-typical lymphocytic infiltrate (0.37 contribution); descriptive context only [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical duct-confined atypia (+0.27 contribution) slightly pushes toward invasive [F4] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Prominent tubules (-0.25 contribution) push away from invasive; caption inconsistent · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-average nuclear pleomorphism (-0.14 contribution) pushes away from invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability more than random (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); minor scores use unreliable necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- A benign lesion is present; Benign probability is 47% and contrast case BACH_0309 (85% similarity) is Benign.
- Simulated frozen-section resampling (severity 3) masks focal atypia, while HoVer-Net cell segmentation is disabled and test ECE is 5%.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 0**: Inspect highest-risk tile (77% risk) where stromal infiltration and nuclear pleomorphism scores peak.
2. **Regions 8, 9**: Check duct-confined atypia, lymphocytes, and 96% medial/inferior margin segments despite clear margin call [F7].
3. **Regions 5, 6**: Evaluate gland/tubule architecture to distinguish Normal tissue from Benign contrast case BACH_0309.
